EntityView.name: v harc snn callout roster
EntityView.commentInRDBMS: /* * v_harc_snn_callout_roster * ------------------------ * * Author: Tim Collier * * Purpose: Generate the weekly call-out roster ordered by last name and first name. First, find the number of cutoff days to use. This will limit the roster * to those who have checked in one time during the past x days, where x is the numbe of cutoff days. * For those who have checked in at least one time during the past x days, find the callsign, first and last names, whether or not they are members. * A provision is made to also always inculde certain call signs. Typically, these are the net controllers, but they could be anyone * who the administrator wishes to automatically include on the callout roster. * */
EntityView.userDefinedSQL:
/* * v_harc_snn_callout_roster * ------------------------ * * Author: Tim Collier * * Purpose: Generate the weekly call-out roster ordered by last name and first name. First, find the number of cutoff days to use. This will limit the roster * to those who have checked in one time during the past x days, where x is the numbe of cutoff days. * For those who have checked in at least one time during the past x days, find the callsign, first and last names, whether or not they are members. * A provision is made to also always inculde certain call signs. Typically, these are the net controllers, but they could be anyone * who the administrator wishes to automatically include on the callout roster. * */ select distinct a.call as 'Callsign' , CASE when v_pers.pers_call is NULL then a.first_name else ifnull(v_pers.pers_nicknam, v_pers.pers_f_nam) END as 'First Name' , a.last_name as 'Last Name' , CASE when v_pers.pers_typ = '1' then 'member' else 'non-member' END as 'Member' , ' ' as 'Comments' , (select current_num_days from v_current_call_out_cutoff_days) as 'Cutoff_Days'
from v_net_qso a LEFT JOIN v_pers on trim(upper(a.Call)) = trim(upper(v_pers.pers_call)) /* * Select those records that show a contest id beginning with HARC-SNN (Sunday Night Net) * as well as those that are within the required number of days (probably 28 days). * There may be some special cases where a call sign is always included */ where substr(a.contest_id, 1, 4) = 'HARC' and date(a.qso_start) > (select date('now', '-' || (select current_num_days from v_current_call_out_cutoff_days) || ' days')) or a.call in ( 'N6YFN' -- Lawrence Roney Net Control , 'K7JTC' -- Tim Collier Net Control , 'KF7JAF' -- Dave Le Blanc Net Control , 'kD7YMO' -- Gerry Grabo Net Control , 'N6SFX' -- Steve Farinella Net Control , 'K7ZEX' -- Tony Fetcho Net Control , 'KF4KF' -- Karol Frodsham Net Control , 'N7WDZ' -- Gene Heiter Net Control ) -- insert comma-separated call signs that will always appear in call-out list order by 4, 3, 2
